programs.name: Hawai‘i veterans: Office of Veterans’ Services for claims help
programs.organization: Hawaii Department of Defense, Office of Veterans’ Services
programs.description: Free help with VA claims, pension, survivor benefits and state veterans benefits from the Office of Veterans’ Services’ veterans services counselors, with offices on O‘ahu (Tripler and Kapolei), Kaua‘i, Hawai‘i Island (Hilo and Kona) and Maui.
programs.next_step: Call your island’s office (choose a county above) or the O‘ahu office at 808-433-0420.
constraints: Most offices see veterans by appointment only; the Tripler and Kapolei offices take walk-ins on set mornings.

sources.title: Hawaii Department of Defense, Office of Veterans’ Services: Contact
sources.scope: Every office’s address, phone, hours and walk-in or appointment rules; read in full. The page is undated.

programs.name: Hawai‘i Aging and Disability Resource Centers (county offices on aging)
programs.organization: Hawaii Executive Office on Aging and the four county Area Agencies on Aging
programs.description: Each county’s office on aging runs its Aging and Disability Resource Center: information on aging, health and disability services, caregiver support, Kupuna Care, legal assistance and transportation. The state Executive Office on Aging coordinates them. Military service is not required.
programs.next_step: Choose a county above for its office on aging, or call the statewide Aging and Disability Resource Center line, 808-643-2372.
constraints: Each program has its own eligibility and waitlist.
programs.phone_label: Hawai‘i Aging and Disability Resource Center (808-643-2372)

programs.name: Medicare counseling (Hawai‘i SHIP)
programs.organization: Hawaii Executive Office on Aging, State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP)
programs.description: Free, one-on-one Medicare counseling from Hawai‘i’s State Health Insurance Assistance Program: plan choices, enrollment, costs and help paying for Medicare, by phone, video or in person.
programs.next_step: Call the Hawai‘i SHIP Helpline at 808-586-7299 or toll-free 888-875-9229, or book at hawaiiship.org. For Medicare itself, call 800-MEDICARE (800-633-4227).
constraints: Counseling is by appointment. Have your Medicare card and drug list ready.

sources.title: Office of the Governor: Hawaii SHIP counseling appointments
sources.scope: Call the Hawaii SHIP Helpline at 808-586-7299 or toll-free 1-888-875-9229; search excerpt.

programs.name: Hawai‘i Long-Term Care Ombudsman and adult abuse reporting
programs.organization: Hawaii Executive Office on Aging, Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program; Department of Human Services, Adult Protective Services
programs.description: Advocacy for residents of nursing homes, care homes, assisted living and other long-term care settings. Adult Protective Services takes reports of abuse, neglect or financial exploitation of vulnerable adults.
programs.next_step: Call the ombudsman at 808-586-7268. To report abuse of a vulnerable adult, call Adult Protective Services at 808-832-5115 (7:45 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. weekdays; leave a message after hours) or report online at apsreport.hawaii.gov. In an emergency, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing agency.

sources.title: Hawaii Department of Human Services: Adult Protective Services brochure (June 2026)
sources.scope: Statewide reporting line (808) 832-5115, hours, after-hours messages and the online form; read in full.

programs.name: Free legal help for Hawai‘i kūpuna
programs.organization: Legal Aid Society of Hawai‘i, Kupuna Legal Aid Services
programs.description: The Legal Aid Society of Hawai‘i offers free legal help to people 60 and older through its Senior Legal Hotline, covering elder law, consumer, housing and public benefits matters, and general civil legal intake for people with low and moderate incomes on all islands.
programs.next_step: If you are 60 or older, call the Senior Legal Hotline: O‘ahu 808-536-0011, neighbor islands 888-536-0011. General intake: O‘ahu 808-536-4302, neighbor islands 888-499-4302 (weekdays 9 to 11:30 a.m. and 1 to 3:30 p.m.).
constraints: Legal aid screens by age, income and case type.
programs.phone_label: Legal Aid Society of Hawai‘i Senior Legal Hotline (808-536-0011)

sources.title: Legal Aid Society of Hawai‘i: Kupuna Legal Aid Services flyer
sources.scope: Senior Legal Hotline O‘ahu 536-0011, neighbor islands 1-888-536-0011; general intake 536-4302 and 1-888-499-4302; search excerpt.

programs.name: VA health care in Hawai‘i
programs.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, VA Pacific Islands Health Care System
programs.description: Hawai‘i veterans are served by the VA Pacific Islands Health Care System: the Spark M. Matsunaga VA Medical Center (459 Patterson Road, Honolulu; 808-433-0600, toll-free 800-214-1306) and clinics on each island.
programs.next_step: Call 808-433-0600 or 800-214-1306 for appointments or the 24/7 VA Health Connect line, or use VA’s facility locator. Not enrolled yet? Ask an Office of Veterans’ Services counselor for help applying.
constraints: Neighbor-island veterans may need to fly to O‘ahu for some specialty care; ask about travel and community care.
programs.phone_label: VA Pacific Islands Health Care System (808-433-0600)
